slice: PR 1 of 3: mode + site + rec parameters + presets
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run sites:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:e2e

localeCoverage.note: Every new string is in both locales; German translation quality is a WP-10 review, not this slice.

sliceBoundaries.ccr: Offered but disabled with a stated reason: toInitialDiveOptions cannot express a setpoint or diluent yet (#158 PR 3).
sliceBoundaries.tec: Enabled. All eight presets plus the rec parameters; helium, gradient factors, AMV, tank size and multiple tanks are PR 2.
sliceBoundaries.sites: All four offered by the screen. The composition root holds RENDERABLE_SITES and shows a stated panel otherwise; it grows with #164-#167.
sliceBoundaries.saveRestore: A restored save still wins over the configuration. Existing resume behaviour, unchanged, flagged in code.

parityToGoldenTrace.rec: default setup == air-18m-30min surface tank (fO2 0.21, 12 L, 200 bar, 2400 L remaining, AMV 15)
parityToGoldenTrace.tec: tec + preset index 4 == trimix-45m-20min surface tank[0] (Tx 21/35)
parityToGoldenTrace.ccr: asserted NOT covered, so the two above are not read as full coverage

acceptance.configuredDiveStarts: e2e: setup screen stands between gate and dive; dive starts with the configured gas
acceptance.keyboardAndPointerEquivalent: e2e compares both paths' oxygen, pressure and in-dive gas readouts, and asserts the configured values (34%, 210 bar) rather than only that the two agree
acceptance.noLiteralStrings: lint passes with the existing no-literal-strings rule
